claim: When a connection times out, a NAT gateway returns an RST packet to resources that try to continue the connection and does not send a FIN; a NAT instance sends a FIN packet to close the connection.
question: What does a NAT gateway send when an idle connection times out?

values.display: a NAT gateway returns an RST packet to any resources behind the NAT gateway that attempt to continue the connection (it does not send a FIN packet)
a NAT instance sends a FIN packet to resources behind the NAT instance to close the connection
